hints.title: Grammar Syntax Tree Tokenization
hints.text: Nested bracket notation defines an explicit parenthetical tree structure where inner lists are nested inside outer enclosing structures.

hints.title: Frame Stack for Nested Contexts
hints.text: Push a new container upon opening brackets. Parse numeric tokens sequentially and attach them to the active top frame. On closing brackets, pop the child and nest it into its parent.

hints.title: Stack Parser Blueprint
hints.text: If string does not start with [, return single integer. Otherwise iterate characters: on [ push NestedInteger; on digits accumulate num with sign; on comma or ] attach completed number; on ] pop container and append to top if stack depth > 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Processes each character exactly once using stack depth bounded by nesting level.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple string splitting breaks due to commas appearing inside deeper nested sub-lists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit frame stack maintains parent-child hierarchical ownership cleanly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of signed negative numbers and single integer strings without brackets.
